plan.summary: BRO-4887: fix the Into the Woods Broadway pages before the West End promo links them: correct the 2022 opening date, clear three false pre-opening flags, file the NY Post and Theatrely reviews correctly, delete misfiled copies in the 1987/1997 pages (the 1997 Washington Post file is kept: it holds a different article), and flag the 2016 London Independent review. Bylines (Observer, NYT) and refetches (amNY, Front Mezz Junkies, Talkin Broadway) are left for a follow-up because they could not be verified from cloud.
steps: Opening night was 2022-07-10: the first-night reviews (NYT, NYSR, Broadway News, amNY, NY Post) are dated 07-10/11 and previews began 06-28. 2022-08-06 came from IBDB and flagged genuine opening reviews as pre-opening.
Genuine Broadway 2022 review (nystagereview.com 2022/07/10, full text). The wrongProduction flag came from the wrong opening date.
Genuine review of the St. James production; the flag was CV-promoted because the publish date preceded the wrong 2022-08-06 opening date.
Genuine opening-night piece (broadwaynews.com 2022/07/10); flagged anticipatory_pre_opening_post only because of the wrong opening date.
Wrongly credited copy of the Theatrely review by Joey Sims (the stored text names Joey Sims). The Joey Sims file stays and its duplicate pointer self-heals once this file is gone.
Johnny Oleksinski NY Post review (nypost.com/2022/07/10/...) was misfiled under the 1987 production; it reviews the 2022 revival.
Date in the review URL (2022/07/10); the stored 1987-11-05 was a fake date from the misfiling.
Flagged misfiled copy of the 2022 NY Post review; the real one is now filed under 2022.
Unflagged misfiled copy of the 2022 NYSR review (url nystagereview.com/2022/07/10); the real one is already filed under 2022.
Misfiled undated copy of the 2022 Theater Pizzazz review; the real one is already filed under 2022.
The Independent review at this url is of the 2016 Menier Chocolate Factory (London) production, not the 1987 Broadway one.
